question: 链式执行时下游收到的 prompt 里必须注入上游 ok 的答案（数据链路最小实现）
verify:
import plan_executor as pe
calls = []
def ok_fn(prompt, preset, timeout):
    calls.append((prompt, preset))
    return {"status": "ok", "answer": "ANSWER(%s)" % preset, "sessionId": "sid"}
subs = [
    {"id": "s1", "text": "写排序", "preset": "standard", "depends_on": [], "protection": False},
    {"id": "s2", "text": "整理纪要", "preset": "daily-assistant", "depends_on": ["s1"], "protection": False}]
state = {"task_id": "t", "need": "n", "plan": {"subtasks": subs},
         "subtasks": {s["id"]: {"status": "pending", "answer": "", "sessionId": ""} for s in subs}}
pe.execute_plan(state, ok_fn)
result = len(calls) == 2 and "上游 s1 的结果" in calls[1][0] and "ANSWER(standard)" in calls[1][0]

question: protection=True 的子任务必须停在 awaiting-user，且一次也不投递给 dispatch_fn
verify:
import plan_executor as pe
calls = []
def ok_fn(prompt, preset, timeout):
    calls.append(prompt)
    return {"status": "ok", "answer": "x", "sessionId": "sid"}
subs = [{"id": "s1", "text": "删除旧文件", "preset": "daily-assistant",
         "depends_on": [], "protection": True}]
state = {"task_id": "t", "need": "n", "plan": {"subtasks": subs},
         "subtasks": {"s1": {"status": "pending", "answer": "", "sessionId": ""}}}
pe.execute_plan(state, ok_fn)
result = (state["subtasks"]["s1"]["status"] == "awaiting-user" and len(calls) == 0)

question: 上游 fail 时下游必须显式 skip 并记录 skip_reason（不静默跑下去）
aggregate 生成的 summary.md 明细表应包含全部 3 个子任务行
verify:
import tempfile, pathlib
import plan_executor as pe
subs = [
    {"id": "s1", "text": "写排序", "preset": "standard", "depends_on": [], "protection": False},
    {"id": "s2", "text": "调模型", "preset": "standard", "depends_on": [], "protection": False},
    {"id": "s3", "text": "删除旧文件", "preset": "daily-assistant", "depends_on": [], "protection": True}]
state = {"task_id": "t", "need": "n", "plan": {"subtasks": subs},
         "subtasks": {"s1": {"status": "ok", "answer": "R1", "sessionId": "sid1"},
                      "s2": {"status": "fail", "dispatch_status": "turn-error: x"},
                      "s3": {"status": "awaiting-user", "skip_reason": "保护层"}}}
p = pe.aggregate(state, pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()))
text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
result = sum(1 for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith("| s"))

import plan_executor as pe
subs = [{"id": "s3", "text": "删除旧文件", "preset": "daily-assistant",
         "depends_on": [], "protection": True}]
state = {"task_id": "t", "need": "n", "plan": {"subtasks": subs},
         "subtasks": {"s3": {"status": "awaiting-user", "skip_reason": "保护层"}}}

question: calib_classify_v1 的 exact_match/n 复算应等于 stats.json 里记的 exact_accuracy（4 位小数）
verify:
import json, pathlib, sys
root = pathlib.Path(sys.path[0])
st = json.loads((root / "calib_classify_v1" / "stats.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
recomputed = st["exact_match"] / st["n"]
result = "%.4f" % recomputed if abs(recomputed - st["exact_accuracy"]) < 1e-9 else "MISMATCH"
